content:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync — one week out from the "Inference @ Scale" demo. Can we confirm registration page copy, Zoom settings (recording+captioning), and post-event lead routing? Need owners.

Jasper (Events): I can own Zoom host/co-host + rehearsal. Zoom settings: record to cloud, enable live transcript, auto-accept co-hosts. Who is uploading the recording after? :spiral_calendar:

Lena (Ops): For upload pipeline — Ops will pick cloud recording -> sanitize -> S3 bucket -> Media team gets a notification. Need the asset tag and filename format. Proposed tag: webinar_inference_march2026. Filename pattern: inference_2026_03_XX_webinar.mp4

Samir (Demand Gen): Routing: HubSpot form on reg page should stamp contact with source=webinar, campaign=inference_march2026, and list membership=webinar_nurture_inference. Immediate MQL rules: +visited_product_page OR +attended_>15min. Also need GA/UTM values for paid promos.

Ruth (Content): I'll finalise registration headline + 2 bullet benefits and the short bio blurbs. Draft copy ready by EOD. Need confirmation on one CTA: 'Register for demo' vs 'Reserve your spot' — preference?

Maeve (Product): For the demo script, we want a short benchmark slide and a live Q&A. Can we reserve 10 mins at the end for product roadmap blurbs? Also tagging note: please include model and throughput tags in the lead metadata (e.g., model=redwood-gnorm, workload=throughput-bench).

Maya (Marketing): CTA: lean to 'Reserve your spot' — feels higher intent. @Ruth please use that. @Samir please set the UTM params: utm_source=redwood_blog, utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=inference_march2026.

Jasper (Events): Zoom settings snippet I'm using: ```
- Cloud recording: ON (host only)
- Automatic live transcript: ON
- Alternative Hosts: jasper@redwood.com, maeve@redwood.com
- Waiting room: OFF (we'll admit attendees)
- Co-hosts enabled: YES
- Chat auto-save: YES
```

ZoomBot: Recording ready-to-download notification will post to #eng-ops channel once processed.

Lena (Ops): For captions/transcripts: we'll pull Zoom VTT, run through the cleanup script, then generate an SRT and a plain text transcript. Clip owners: @Ruth for marketing clips, @Maeve for product-specific clips.

Samir (Demand Gen): Lead routing Zap (form -> HubSpot) example: ```
POST /webhooks/zapier/hubspot
headers: {"content-type":"application/json"}
body: {"email":"{{email}}","properties": {"source":"webinar","campaign":"inference_march2026","tags":["webinar","inference"]}}
```

Maya (Marketing): Post-event tasks: 1) Upload edited recording + transcript to Assets, 2) Send replay email within 24 hrs to registrants + non-attenders, 3) Start 3-email nurture (day 1 replay, day 4 deep dive, week 2 benchmark case study). Who owns replay email?

Ruth (Content): I'll draft replay email + 3-email nurture flows. Need raw recording timestamp and a 90s highlight clip from Events.

Jasper (Events): I'll push the highlight clip to the Slack channel and tag owners. ETA for edited clip: 36 hours post-event.

Maeve (Product): Suggest adding a short eval/feedback form link in the replay email to capture feature interest and production constraints. Simple 3-question form.

Samir (Demand Gen): Also segment the attendees: Attended (>=15m) -> Sales Notified; Registered but no-show -> nurture with demo CTA. Create lists: "Inference_Attended" and "Inference_Registered_NoShow".

Maya (Marketing): Owners recap: Registration page + copy: @Ruth; Zoom host/rehearsal + recording owner: @Jasper; Upload pipeline + S3 tag: @Lena; Lead routing + UTM: @Samir; Product clips + roadmap notes: @Maeve. I'll create calendar invites for rehearsal and a follow-up checklist doc.

Lena (Ops): One security/permissions note: recordings will include Q&A which may contain customer names — we'll run PII scrub script before wider distribution.

Samir (Demand Gen): Anything for paid ads team? I'll queue the creative with UTM set and biddable dates.

Maya (Marketing): Great. Final ask: everyone confirm by EOD. If no objections, we'll publish reg page tomorrow 09:00 PT. :white_check_mark:
